caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Strong Winds, High Swell Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained winds of 23 kt, waves up to 5.3 ft, a swell period of 8 s from the ENE, and 62% rain probability. I note that St. Lucia will see winds up to 11 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Faces Heavy Rain, Light Winds, 1.7ft Waves
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing 75% rain probability, with maximum sustained winds of 14 kt and mean wave height of 1.7 ft, while the dominant swell period is 4 s from the ENE. I note Barcelona sees 11 kt winds and calmer conditions.
